card.name: Words before creeping, gradual onset
card.fires_on: Points in a sentence where the next word is likely to describe something happening stealthily or gradually, such as insidiously, silently, slowly creeping or encroaching. It fires on the verb, adverb or word start just before that.

modes.label: Start of insidious
modes.description: The first part of the word insidiously, describing symptoms that appear hidden or gradual.
modes.example: Signs of overdose may appear suddenly or<< ins>>idiously.

modes.label: Verb or adverb before creeping
modes.description: A linking verb or adverb after a subject that is spreading quietly, before a word like stealing, encroaching or silent.
modes.example: But one other novelty is<< slowly>> stealing the spotlight.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning sneaking or creeping (sne-, cre-, stealth), as in sneak or creep.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about to say something creeps in quietly or gradually.
